comment: Startsidans bildcollage 'Matstrumpor i världen' (Axels beställning 2026-09-29: 'bilder med UGC-kreatörer och olika flaggor för vart vi säljer … strumporna lite överallt i de olika länderna … bara på startsidan'). Bilderna genereras av kie.ai (nano-banana-edit) med butikens egna produktfoton som referens, så att strumporna ser ut som de riktiga. Personerna är AI-genererade: rutorna bär bara landets namn, aldrig ett citat, ett namn eller 'kund' — de får aldrig se ut som recensioner.
stil: Hyperrealistic amateur smartphone snapshot taken by a friend, NOT a stock photo, NOT a studio shot: warm indoor lamp light or on-camera flash, slight grain, imperfect casual framing, a real lived-in home with everyday clutter, ordinary-looking people with natural skin, no posing for the camera. Match the look of the third reference image (candid feet on a sofa, warm yellow light). The socks and the black sushi gift box must look exactly like the product in the first two reference images (salmon nigiri, maki rolls, tamago, striped salmon/red/black/yellow socks). No text, no words, no letters, no logos, no watermarks anywhere. Square composition.

karta.prompt: Hyperrealistic amateur phone photo, top-down, on a worn wooden floor in warm evening lamp light: an opened brown cardboard parcel with the black sushi sock gift box inside, three more plain brown parcels stacked next to it, an old paper desk globe beside them, a pair of the striped sushi socks thrown on top. Casual, slightly grainy, real home, not a stock photo. The socks and gift box must look exactly like the reference images. No text, no labels, no letters, no logos anywhere.

rutor.prompt: Swedish birthday at a pine kitchen table in the evening: a laughing middle-aged woman just opened the sushi sock gift box, a homemade cake with tiny paper Swedish flags (blue with yellow cross) stuck in it, coffee cups, on-camera flash.

Cozy Norwegian cabin living room in winter: two pairs of feet wearing the striped sushi socks up on a wooden coffee table next to a thermos, a small Norwegian flag (red with blue cross outlined in white) in a jar on the windowsill, snowy mountains visible through the window.

Danish family kitchen at a kid's birthday: a string of small Danish flag bunting (red with a white Nordic cross) across the kitchen, a boy around ten grinning and holding up the opened black sushi sock gift box with both hands (salmon nigiri, maki rolls, tamago clearly visible), cake on the table, flash photo.

Finnish summer cottage porch by a lake: bare legs stretched out on a wooden bench, feet wearing the striped sushi socks, a Finnish flag (white with blue cross) on a tall flagpole by the lake in the background, soft evening light.

German old-building apartment living room during a football evening: three friends' feet in sushi socks resting on a coffee table with beer bottles and crisps, a black-red-gold German flag hanging on the wall behind the sofa, warm lamp light.

Small Paris apartment in the morning: feet in the striped sushi socks resting on a little balcony railing, a croissant and coffee cup on a tiny table, Paris zinc rooftops outside, a small blue-white-red French tricolour paper flag in a glass.

Italian grandmother's kitchen: an elderly Italian man laughing at the table with a pizza, holding the opened sushi sock gift box, an Italian flag tea towel (green, white, red stripes) hanging on the oven, warm light, flash.

Sunny Spanish apartment terrace with terracotta tiles and plants: feet in the sushi socks propped on a plastic chair, a glass of lemonade, a red-yellow-red Spanish flag hanging from the neighbour's balcony across the street.

Dutch living room on King's Day: a young woman in an orange t-shirt laughing on the sofa, feet in the striped sushi socks up on the coffee table, the gift box on her lap, through the big window a Dutch flag with exactly three equal horizontal stripes (red on top, white middle, blue bottom) hangs from the house across the street.
British living room on a rainy evening: feet in the sushi socks on a patterned sofa, a mug of tea with milk, a biscuit tin, Union Jack bunting strung above the fireplace, warm lamp light.

American suburban backyard on the 4th of July: a smiling dad in a baseball cap holding up a pair of sushi socks, the gift box on a picnic table with burgers, small American flags stuck in the lawn, late afternoon sun.

Australian backyard barbecue in summer: feet in the striped sushi socks with rubber flip-flops on a sunny wooden deck, a stubby holder drink, an Australian flag hanging on the fence, bright harsh sunlight.
